data.exact_reserve_text: A favourable run off deviation (prior accident year release) of GBP 650k (2014: GBP 343k unfavourable deviation) was experienced during the year.
data.standardized_narrative: For the year ended 31 December 2015 Syndicate 3002 recorded a prior accident year release of GBP 0.65m, representing favourable claims development against opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 3.303m (the 2014 comparative long term business provision). The movement is reported as a favourable runoff deviation and has been treated as a release of prior reserves.
raw_causal_phrases: A favourable run off deviation (prior accident year release) of GBP 650k (2014: GBP 343k unfavourable deviation) was experienced during the year.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year movement is taken from Note 10 narrative which states a GBP 650k favourable runoff deviation. The note does not explicitly label this figure as gross or net of reinsurance; the movement is therefore taken as reported in the 'Movement in prior year's provision' note. A gross claims development triangle is present but formatting and an RITC disclosure (RITC into 2014) make triangle-based extraction unreliable. The syndicate writes term life business; mapping to the standard LOB 'Accident & Health' is an inference.
